patterns.message: A payment request follows an offer or selection claim.
Time pressure appears later in the conversation.

recommendations: Pause before paying any unexpected fee; confirm it through an independently found official channel.
Do not share passwords or one-time codes.
Verify claims using contact details you find independently.
Completing a checklist does not establish that an offer is genuine, and a low score does not prove a message is safe.

verificationChecklist.title: Find the organization's official website independently
verificationChecklist.why: A link or contact supplied in a suspicious message may lead to an impersonator.

verificationChecklist.title: Check the offer on an official careers, program, or announcements page
verificationChecklist.why: An independently located official listing can help confirm the claim.

verificationChecklist.title: Compare the sender's address with the organization's official domain
verificationChecklist.why: Lookalike or unrelated domains can indicate impersonation; matching domains alone are not proof.

verificationChecklist.title: Investigate any unexpected fee or payment request before paying
verificationChecklist.why: Upfront fees deserve careful checking through official channels.

verificationChecklist.title: Do not provide passwords, one-time codes, or unnecessary financial details
verificationChecklist.why: Legitimate organizations should not need your password or OTP.
